stories.text: President Lula of Brazil is re-elected for a fourth term, edging out right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the former president, in a close vote.
Storm Boelo cuts power to about 90,000 properties across Scotland and northern England, and the Met Office has issued a fresh wind warning.
Healey plans to keep lower-income pensioners out of income tax in the Budget, as the full state pension is due to rise in April.
A daughter who looked after her elderly mother at home wins a claim of 127,000 pounds, after a painful dispute with her siblings.
London's Oxford Street has been pedestrianised, and the first phase of the work is due to finish by spring 2027.
Senior consultant doctors in England will strike for 48 hours from 25 November in a dispute over pay and pensions.
Serbia celebrates as veteran leader Aleksandar Vucic concedes defeat to a student-led protest movement after 12 years in power.
Prime Minister Burnham does not rule out a referendum on EU free movement and wants a debate on the UK's future ties with Europe.
Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Machado returns to cheering crowds after more than ten months in exile, having fled the country by speedboat.
Prince William says knighting rugby league star Kevin Sinfield was an easy decision, adding the honour should have come years ago.
